title: Syracuse University responds to Wall Street Journal article: SU ‘is far from a crisis’
summary: Syracuse University's Chancellor issued a public statement responding to Wall Street Journal reporting on student enrollment challenges, asserting the institution remains fiscally sound. This represents institutional crisis management and reputational defense in response to media scrutiny.

political_signal.description: Media scrutiny of major regional institution's financial health and enrollment viability; institutional leadership responding defensively to third-party reporting
